overview.name: FT Vest Gold Strategy Quarterly Buffer ETF
overview.description: Under normal market conditions, the fund will invest substantially all of its assets in U.S. Treasury securities, cash and cash equivalents, and in the shares of a wholly-owned subsidiary (the “Subsidiary”) that holds FLexible EXchange® Options (“FLEX Options”) that reference the price performance of the SPDR® Gold Trust. The fund is non-diversified.
